topics.name: Markov Chains
topics.description: A mathematical system that undergoes transitions from one state to another on a state space.

sub_topics.name: Transition Matrix
sub_topics.description: A matrix that describes the probabilities of transitioning from one state to another.

sub_topics.name: Markov Property
sub_topics.description: The principle that the future state depends only on the current state, not on the sequence of events that preceded it.

sub_topics.name: Stationary Distribution
sub_topics.description: A probability distribution that remains unchanged as time passes in a Markov chain.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of probability and statistics.
common_misconceptions: Markov chains are only for discrete states
Future states depend on more than just the current state

topics.name: Probabilities
topics.description: The measure of the likelihood that an event will occur.

sub_topics.name: Probability Matrix
sub_topics.description: A matrix that represents the probabilities of different outcomes.

sub_topics.name: Transition Probabilities
sub_topics.description: The probabilities associated with moving from one state to another in a Markov process.

sub_topics.name: Probability Vectors
sub_topics.description: Vectors that represent the probabilities of being in each state.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of statistics and algebra.
common_misconceptions: Probability is the same as certainty
Independent events do not affect each other

topics.name: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
topics.description: Key concepts in linear algebra that are used in various machine learning algorithms.

sub_topics.name: Eigenvalue Magnitude
sub_topics.description: The absolute value of an eigenvalue, which can indicate the stability of a system.

sub_topics.name: Associated Eigenvalue
sub_topics.description: An eigenvalue that corresponds to a specific eigenvector.

sub_topics.name: Eigenvalue Multiplicity
sub_topics.description: The number of times an eigenvalue appears in the characteristic polynomial.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of linear algebra, including matrices and vectors.

topics.name: Clustering
topics.description: A machine learning technique used to group similar data points together.

sub_topics.name: Clustering Properties
sub_topics.description: Characteristics that define how well a clustering algorithm performs.

sub_topics.name: Rationale Clustering
sub_topics.description: The reasoning behind choosing specific clustering methods for data analysis.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of statistics and linear algebra.
common_misconceptions: Clustering is the same as classification
All clusters are spherical in shape

topics.name: Graph Theory
topics.description: The study of graphs, which are mathematical structures used to model pairwise relations between objects.

sub_topics.name: Transition Graphs
sub_topics.description: Graphs that represent the states and transitions of a Markov process.

sub_topics.name: Graph Models
sub_topics.description: Mathematical representations of real-world systems using graphs.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of discrete mathematics and familiarity with sets and functions.
common_misconceptions: Graphs are only for computer science applications

topics.name: Traffic Prediction
topics.description: The use of algorithms to forecast traffic conditions based on historical data.

sub_topics.name: Congestion Prediction
sub_topics.description: Estimating traffic congestion levels in urban areas.

sub_topics.name: Road Traffic Analysis
sub_topics.description: The study of traffic patterns and behaviors on road networks.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of statistics and machine learning principles.
common_misconceptions: Only historical data is needed for predictions

topics.name: Neural Networks
topics.description: Computational models inspired by the human brain, used for various machine learning tasks.

sub_topics.name: Activation Function
sub_topics.description: A function that determines the output of a neural network node.

sub_topics.name: Backpropagation
sub_topics.description: An algorithm for training neural networks by minimizing the error.

sub_topics.name: Loss Function
sub_topics.description: A function that quantifies the difference between predicted and actual outcomes.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of linear algebra and calculus, familiarity with programming concepts.
common_misconceptions: Neural networks can learn without data
More layers always mean better performance

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning
topics.description: A type of machine learning where an agent learns to make decisions by receiving rewards or penalties.

sub_topics.name: Theory of Reinforcement
sub_topics.description: The foundational principles that guide reinforcement learning algorithms.

sub_topics.name: Policy Optimization
sub_topics.description: The process of improving the decision-making policy of an agent.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of machine learning and probability theory.
common_misconceptions: Reinforcement learning is the same as supervised learning
Rewards always lead to optimal behavior

topics.name: Bike Sharing Systems
topics.description: Urban transportation systems that allow users to rent bicycles for short periods.

sub_topics.name: Bike Stations
sub_topics.description: Locations where bicycles can be rented or returned.

sub_topics.name: Predicting Congestion
sub_topics.description: Forecasting demand and usage patterns in bike sharing systems.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of urban transportation systems and data analysis.
common_misconceptions: Bike sharing is only for tourists
All bike sharing systems are the same
